raw_segments.text: Oh, I've nothing against God. Of course, God is only a hypothesis, but I admit that He is needed,
for the order of the universe and all that, and that if there were no God He would have to be
invented," added Kalia, beginning to blush. He suddenly fancied that Alyosha might think he
was trying to show off his knowledge and to prove that he was grown up.
I haven't the slightest desire to show off my knowledge to him,
Kalia thought indignantly, and all of a sudden he felt horribly annoyed.
